title: Top 2027 Badgers' Offensive Line target set to remain in the B1G - NewsBreak
text:
By Jarrett Guerrera ,
1 days ago The 2027 recruiting cycle is heating up for everyone and the Wisconsin Badgers are right in the thick of things at the moment.
A top target along the offensive line announced his commitment decision live recently and included Wisconsin on the table. Four-star Illinois native Cameron Wagner sat down and made his choice between Wisconsin, Oregon, Illinois, and Notre Dame.
Wagner, a 6-foot-6 offensive tackle, has largely been considered to be one of the better offensive lineman in the 2027 recruiting cycle. The tackle is currently the 345th overall recruit in the class and the 36th offensive tackle in the class. Wagner is additionally ranked as the 13th best recruit in the state of Illinois, proudly representing St. Joseph-Ogden.
The Badgers previously offered Wagner a scholarship back in December before really building a strong foundation. Wagner was on campus for a visit in April as he made his spring visit rounds. The Badgers managed to secure an Official Visit for the end of May with Wagner, but the recruit opted to sit behind the table and make a commitment decision before taking any officials.
Oct 18, 2025; Madison, Wisconsin, USA; Wisconsin Badgers head coach Luke Fickell during warmups prior to the game against the Ohio State Buckeyes at Camp Randall Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jeff Hanisch-Imagn Images Wagner only needed to step on campus in Eugene one time before he knew his future would be with the Oregon Ducks. The offensive lineman stopped by during his recent spring visits and left thoroughly impressed with both the program and the campus.
Following his commitment to the Ducks, Wagner stated that the connection between Coach Dan Lanning and his players was a major factor. Wagner believes Lanning is still “a coach” rather than someone who is overseeing operations.
For the Badgers, missing out on an impressive recruit in a state where the program typically has success is unfortunate. However, the fact that Wisconsin was able to make the final cut for Wagner is both a good sign and part of a growing trend for the Badgers’ staff.
Wisconsin has had trouble staying on the radar of top ranked recruits for the past few seasons between results on the field and coaching changes. The Badgers are now back in the picture for the majority of the big name recruits in the 2027 class after striking in-state gold early.
The Badgers are expected to also be on the table for notable recruits such as Jett Watson , Yahzeen Zion , and Darryl Flemister .
